QuestInfo.name: [Zero Up] Zero Level-Up Support Event
QuestInfo.0:
#e#bZero Up Event#k#n

#eZero Level-Up Support Benefits!#n

- Event Period:
6/6/2018 after maintenance to
6/19/2018 at 11:59 PM

- New and Existing Zero Characters
   Receive #b2x EXP Coupon (30 min) x2#k every day!
   #r(Once per world)#k
- Receive Mirror World #bDungeon Clear WP 2x#k!


#eZero Mission Reward Benefits!#n
- Event Period:
6/6/2018 after maintenance to
6/19/2018 at 11:59 PM

- Receive #bZero rewards#k each time you clear a mission!
   #r(Once per world)#k
- Once you've gotten Zero rewards, you can also get #bbonus rewards#k
   with the character of your choice in that world!
   #r(Once per world)#k
